summary: Full backend + frontend review for the Küçük Şirket Yönetim app. 15/15 backend pytest cases passed (auth, incomes, expenses, invoices with VAT breakdown + xlsx import + bad-type rejection, inventory remaining calc, spendings category filter, todos complete timestamp, activity logs ordering, dashboard summary). Frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL: login (quick-login), dashboard, sidebar navigation to all 7 sections, income create with auto date + footer total + delete, invoice create with amount 1200 showing VAT preview 200 and row (gross 1200/VAT 200), VAT monthly summary card visible, stock product create with required=10/received=4 showing remaining=6 preview and persisted row, Harcamalar 3 tabs switching, Spending create, Todo create + checkbox toggle setting completed_at, Activity Log search filter, Logout returns to /login.

issues: Quick-login buttons perform login immediately on click (no separate submit needed) - works fine but slightly non-obvious; UX is acceptable

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 748 lines - consider splitting routers (auth, finance, inventory, todos, logs) into separate modules for maintainability.
Password seeding reads USER1_PASSWORD/USER2_PASSWORD directly from env; fine for 2-user app but no password change endpoint is exposed (by design per spec).

update_income/update_expense/update_invoice use find_one_and_update without return_document=After; function returns None if default is Before but code still re-fetches via find_one - works but inconsistent. Harmless.
VAT summary iterates in Python; fine for small volume but a Mongo aggregation would scale better.
Login endpoint has no brute-force lockout (playbook recommends 5-fail lockout). Low risk given 2 seeded users only, but worth noting.

CORS: allow_origins defaults to '*' when CORS_ORIGINS unset; combined with allow_credentials=True this is technically invalid per CORS spec. Browsers may reject. Preview env currently works via same-origin ingress so not blocking.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed data per test case and clean up (delete) at end of each test. Frontend tests also create TEST_UI_* entries but may leave some rows (incomes/invoices/stock/spending/todo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and runs via pytest-xdist (2 workers). Includes xlsx import generated in-memory via openpyxl. If adding tests, remember login endpoint logs activity, so activity_logs grows. Public URL: https://accounting-app-207.preview.emergentagent.com.
